BLDC.description: Building Control Data (BLDC). A single-instance (key = 1) definition; the bSTORY_CENTER flag plus USE_OPTION drive which story-shear-ratio load-case fields apply, and bSTORY_RESPONSE_THRS drives the story-center method.

bBASE_LEVEL.description: Consider Ground Level. When true, BASE_LEVEL, bBEDROCK_LEVEL and bINCLUDE_BASE_MASS become meaningful.

bBEDROCK_LEVEL.description: [bBASE_LEVEL=true] Consider Underground Seismic Loads. When true, BEDROCK_LEVEL becomes meaningful.

bINCLUDE_BASE_MASS.description: [bBASE_LEVEL=true] Consider Mass below Ground Level for Eigenvalue Analysis.

bSTORY_SHEAR_RATIO.description: Seismic Accidental Eccentricity / story shear ratio flag.

bCONSIDER_WIND_SEIS_FOR_FLEX.description: Consider Wind and Seismic Loads for Flexible Floors.

bSTORY_CENTER.description: Consider Story Shear Force Ratio (story-center evaluation). When true, USE_OPTION, STSF_LCNAME_X, STSF_LCNAME_Y and the USE_OPTION-dependent load-case fields become meaningful.

USE_OPTION.description: [bSTORY_CENTER=true] Use Mass / Use Axial Force / Use Shear Force. Case-insensitive. AXIAL uses BLDC_CASE_ITEMS; SHEAR uses SEIS_LCNAME_X/Y.

BLDC_CASE_ITEMS.description: [bSTORY_CENTER=true, USE_OPTION=AXIAL] Building Control Cases. Must contain at least one item; each LCNAME must reference an existing static load case.

LCNAME.description: Load Case name (must reference an existing static load case).

SCALE_FACTOR.description: Scale Factor applied to the load case.

SEIS_LCNAME_X.description: [bSTORY_CENTER=true, USE_OPTION=SHEAR] Seismic Load Case name, X-Dir (must reference an existing load case).

SEIS_LCNAME_Y.description: [bSTORY_CENTER=true, USE_OPTION=SHEAR] Seismic Load Case name, Y-Dir (must reference an existing load case).

STSF_LCNAME_X.description: [bSTORY_CENTER=true] Story Stiffness Center Load Case name, X-Dir (must reference an existing load case).

STSF_LCNAME_Y.description: [bSTORY_CENTER=true] Story Stiffness Center Load Case name, Y-Dir (must reference an existing load case).

bSTORY_RESPONSE_THRS.description: Consider Story Response of Time History Results. When true, STORY_CENTER_METHOD becomes meaningful.

enum: Story Drift by Maximum of Vertical Elements
STORY_CENTER_METHOD.default: Story Drift by Maximum of Vertical Elements
STORY_CENTER_METHOD.description: [bSTORY_RESPONSE_THRS=true] Story Center Method. Case-insensitive; wire values (with spaces) are enforced at runtime.

1.STORY_CENTER_METHOD: Story Drift by Maximum of Vertical Elements
